row.team_price_text: Contact Sales (quote by hosts; no public tiers)
row.evidence: Sysdig documents no SCIM endpoint: users are created on first SAML or OpenID login ('Create User on Login') and IdP groups map to Sysdig teams and roles at sign-in.
row.notes: New row. Sysdig (Secure CNAPP and Monitor) is quote-only: the pricing page has no plans or prices, licensing is per host (or time series for Monitor) via 'Request a quote'. No SCIM in the 861-page docs sitemap; provisioning is JIT on SAML/OIDC login with group mappings to teams and roles, and users are deactivated manually or by an inactivity rule set via API (SSO login reactivates them). SAML/OIDC guides for Okta, Entra (non-gallery), Google Workspace (custom SAML) and OneLogin use custom apps. Okta's OIN 'Sysdig' app is a log-ingestion (API) integration for Sysdig's Okta threat detection, not SSO or provisioning. The full REST API reference is in-app per region; public docs show only group-mapping and platform-audit endpoints.

scim.notes: Not offered by absence: no SCIM page in docs.sysdig.com/en/sitemap.xml (861 URLs); provisioning is SAML/OIDC JIT plus group mapping.

auth.notes: Bearer token: user API token, team-based or global service account.

capabilities.notes: Group mappings (IdP group to team/role) are manageable by API; user CRUD endpoints are not in the public docs.

endpoints.purpose: List group mappings (IdP group to team/role)
Change a group mapping by ID

user_api.notes: Endpoint reference is served inside the product (Next Gen API Docs per region; render blocked), so user endpoints are not public. Users docs say inactivity-based deactivation is configured through the API.

okta.notes: The OIN 'Sysdig' app ticks only API (Centralized Logging use case): it streams Okta events to Sysdig Secure. SSO uses a custom SAML or OIDC app per Sysdig's guide.

entra.notes: Non-gallery app; no Sysdig tutorial in Microsoft Learn's SaaS index.

google.notes: Custom SAML application; Google OAuth sign-in also supported.

onelogin.notes: From Sysdig's own guide (SAML Custom Connector (Advanced)).

fallbacks.other_sync: SAML/OIDC group mapping of IdP groups to Sysdig teams and roles at login

citations.title: Authentication and Authorization (SaaS)
citations.quote: Sysdig supports authenticating users using Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML), Google OAuth, and OpenID Connect protocols and certifies different Identity Providers (IdPs) that use these protocols, including but not limited to, Okta, OneLogin, and Entra ID.
